name: Soft Breathable Baby Pillow | Newborn Head Shaping Cushion for Flat Head Prevention
description:
Give your baby the right support with this Soft Breathable Baby Pillow designed to prevent flat head syndrome. Made with skin-friendly foamic material, it gently cradles the head while promoting proper sleeping posture. Lightweight, portable, and easy to clean, this pillow is perfect for cribs, strollers, beds, and car seats, ensuring comfort and safety at home or on-the-go.
Key Features
 Prevents flat head in newborns with ergonomic design
 Soft foamic material, breathable and skin-friendly
 Suitable for crib, stroller, bed, car seat, and travel
 Lightweight, portable, and durable for daily use
 Easy to clean and maintain for parents’ convenience
 Random color design, reusable and long-lasting
Ingredients / Materials
Soft foamic material
How to Use
 Place pillow in crib, stroller, or car seat
 Lay baby’s head gently in the center
 Use consistently to help maintain healthy head shape
Package Includes
 1 × Soft Breathable Baby Head Shaping Pillow (Random Color, Without Box)
